players.product: Indium phosphide (InP) wafers (2-4 inch) for optical-communication lasers and detectors, made by subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials; also gallium arsenide wafers and germanium products (germanium ingots, germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber, solar germanium wafers, infrared optics)

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 731,802,060.72, up 38.21% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 74,269,889.52, up 235.31%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 66,903,581.31, up 770.09%; operating cash flow RMB -156,785,010.72. The company attributes the profit growth to higher gross margins in compound semiconductors, material-grade and fiber-grade germanium (overall gross margin up 3.89%) and higher compound-semiconductor and material-grade germanium sales. H1 R&D investment RMB 70,315,961.08, up 46.51%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 by product (half-year report): compound semiconductor materials (gallium arsenide and indium phosphide wafers) RMB 142,080,287.95, up 154.57% (19.42% of revenue), gross margin 47.14%, up 33.10 points - the company says strong data-center and optical-communication demand lifted compound-semiconductor sales volume significantly, InP average selling prices rose sharply on persistently tight supply and demand, and unit cost fell as capacity utilisation rose; subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials posted H1 net profit of RMB 5,705.74 ten-thousand. Material-grade germanium RMB 329,699,918.77 (+112.83%, delivery of previously signed contracts); fiber-grade germanium RMB 106,754,119.53 (-8.27%, gross margin 26.14%); solar-grade germanium RMB 90,369,294.46 (-26.87%); infrared-grade germanium RMB 33,614,388.51 (-49.01%). Contract liabilities rose to RMB 49,866,784.89 (from RMB 1,589,450.06), mainly advance receipts on compound-semiconductor sales contracts.
quarterly_data.figure: compound semiconductor materials RMB 142,080,287.95 (+154.57%), gross margin 47.14% (+33.10 points); contract liabilities RMB 49,866,784.89

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 output (half-year report): 9.18 ten-thousand InP wafers (2-4 inch), 6.56 ten-thousand GaAs wafers (1-6 inch), fiber-grade germanium 15.90 tonnes, solar germanium wafers 37.46 ten-thousand (4-6 inch), material-grade germanium 37.56 tonnes. The company says its InP and GaAs wafers have passed certification at well-known domestic and overseas customers and are in volume use.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (half-year report, June 30, 2026): the high-quality InP single-crystal wafer project (budget RMB 188,560,000.00) had RMB 46,417,699.12 invested, 30.44% progress; the space solar-cell germanium wafer project (budget RMB 307,650,000.00) reached 50.41% progress; the high-quality GaAs wafer project 6.13%; the germanium-slag rare-metal recovery project 1.22%; the advanced germanium materials project (1.36%) is behind plan because of a municipal planning adjustment at its site. All are under construction and not yet at capacity. Construction in progress RMB 139,642,818.99.
